messages.author: 96b7a8417e9b0c75
messages.subject: LD residuals error
parts:
Dear Phil,

Thanks for all your support! It's really great!

I have a new question/bug?

I've been trying to compute LD residuals, which I have done sucessufilly in the past.

But now, both methods show the same "Error". Below I reproduce my script and error.

ld1 <- residuals (graded2,type="LD")

Error in .Call("gradedTraceLinePts", par, Theta, itemexp, ot, FALSE) : 
  "gradedTraceLinePts" not resolved from current namespace (mirt)

out <- residuals(graded2, df.p = TRUE, verbose=FALSE)

Error in .Call("gradedTraceLinePts", par, Theta, itemexp, ot, FALSE) : 
  "gradedTraceLinePts" not resolved from current namespace (mirt)

I'm not sure if is something with my package version (1.28)

Thanks for your help!

Best wishes, Lucas

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: LD residuals error
parts:
This looks like it could be something with your R session itself. Try re-install mirt, and close/re-oping R to see if the problem goes away. HTH.

Phil
